senses.definition: A true desire sustained or prolonged.

quotes.text: An oil lamp burned upon a high, old-fashioned mantel, casting its dim rays over a dozen repulsive figures. All but one were men. The other was a woman of about thirty. Her face, marked by low passions and dissipation, might once have been lovely.

senses.definition: Any great, strong, powerful emotion, especially romantic love or extreme hate.
examples: We share a passion for books.

quotes.text: That was partly because of a swirling wind that made precision passing difficult and also a derby atmosphere where the emphasis seemed to be on passion rather than football.

senses.definition: An object of passionate or romantic love or strong romantic interest.
examples: It started as a hobby, but now my motorbike collection has become my passion.

senses.definition: Sexual intercourse, especially when very emotional.
examples: We shared a night of passion.
